en.t: The woman's range of topics was very narrow.

units.source_text: 可是，一旦进入她自己的生活圈子，马上就会带来令人刮目相看的活泼。

en.t: But once she entered the sphere of her own life, she immediately brought with her a liveliness that made one see her in a new light.

units.source_text: 这大概是往女人心里去的通道吧。

en.t: This was probably the passageway into a woman's heart.

units.source_text: 当然，那通道并没有什么特别诱人的地方。

en.t: Of course, there was nothing especially alluring about that passageway.

units.source_text: 女人的话具有弹性，甚至能令人感到厚厚劳动裤底下隐藏着的肉体。

en.t: The woman's words had a certain elasticity, enough even to make one sense the body hidden beneath her thick work trousers.
